title: making a game with my wife while we wait for our twins to be born.
author: namenu
selftext:
It’s a tycoon-style game that she usually enjoys.

Since it is still in the early stages, so it’s only playable in an auto-play mode.

https://udongsoba.vercel.app

\- It’s built using Phaser.

\- It took much more time to create tools, animations and FXs than the game itself.

\- AI sucks at pixel art

\- I admire game developers even more than before

comments.author: Unubore
comments.body:
The art is pretty consistent, and I love the little posters in the back. Was the art generated with AI?

The animations are very satisfying as well. Did you have any games you looked to for inspiration?

replies.author: namenu
replies.body:
Thanks!

Yes it's typical nanobanana -> pixellabs -> manual touch workflow.

Animations/prefab generation is on pixellabs.
At first glance the quality of the output looks great but you will find inconsistency everywhere so I ended up retouching the sprites pixel by pixel.
Almost 99% of the time consumed by manual editing, while you still see palette inconsistency.

Inspirations are from LLMs, zero shot prompts with
many tried.

replies.author: Unubore
replies.body: Ah nanobanana for the first generation is a good idea. I was considering using something before PixelLabs to get consistancy but I was mostly thinking about MidJourney. Definitely can tell you have an eye for detail.

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: Retro Diffusion will get you way better consistency- I know because I made it, and was a professional pixel artist for 7 years :)

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body: Cool :). What a great time spent. I like how you think autoplay first :)! 100% agree

comments.author: pixelLegion
comments.body: My girlfriend is crazy about this kind game… shawarma…
